name: 44011 · Avon, OH
findings: ZIP 44011 (Avon) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44011 (Avon) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44011 (Avon) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).
